title: Console: Custom Query Template Marketplace & Governance for Tenant Exports
creator: Mateo Ruiz
description: Build a first-class 'Query Template Marketplace' inside Console that lets customers create, share, and apply parameterized export/query templates for usage, cost, and token-level analytics while enforcing tenant governance policies and export controls.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can create and publish parameterized query templates (CSV/JSON) with safe execution rules and field-level redaction metadata.
Workspace-level governance controls allow admins to whitelist templates, restrict template sharing, or require review before publishing.
Templates can be executed on-demand and scheduled; resulting exports obey tenant rate limits, retention policies, and PII redaction settings.
Console UI provides preview mode (sample rows) with masked sensitive fields before export and shows estimated cost and token counts for scheduled runs.
API endpoints are available to list, apply, and schedule templates programmatically with RBAC checks and audit logging.
Telemetry emits template usage metrics (runs, latencies, token-cost estimates) to Console dashboards and billing attribution pipelines.
Security review sign-off exists for template DSL and sandboxing approach before GA (security_review_required = true).
work_items: Design: Template UX flows — create, parameterize, preview, publish, fork (DES-4312)
PM: Define governance policy model and admin controls; map to existing RBAC (this ticket)
Eng: Template DSL executor service with sandboxing/quotas (ENG-19821)
Eng: Export scheduler integration with rate limiter & retention enforcement (ENG-19902)
Eng: Audit log and telemetry hooks for every template run (ENG-19980)
Docs: PRD + how-to guide and example templates for finance/legal teams
notes: Motivation: Large enterprise customers want curated, repeatable exports for finance and security audits without ad-hoc engineering work.
Problem: Current ad-hoc CSV exports lead to inconsistent fields, missing redaction, and unpredictable costs for scheduled jobs.
Opportunity: A template marketplace reduces support load, standardizes exports, and enables cost-estimation surfaced to customers before scheduling.
Trade-offs: Powerful templating increases risk of data leakage; we will limit DSL capabilities and default to safe field sets for non-admins.
decisions: Template DSL will be declarative (field selectors + aggregations + filters) rather than full SQL to reduce injection risk.
Preview mode returns a sampled, masked dataset (max 500 rows) and does not count toward audit retention for exported artifacts.
Only workspace admins can publish templates to the org marketplace by default; a review flow will be built for cross-team publishing.
Scheduler default cadence will include a conservative rate-limit; customers can request increased throughput via Dedicated capacity channels.
next_steps: Run a 1-week discovery with 3 enterprise customers to validate template requirements and example queries (CS-led).
Design to ship low-fidelity flows for PM review by 2025-03-18.
Engineering spike to validate sandboxed execution and cost estimation within 2 sprints (ENG-19821).
Security to draft policy and threat model for DSL by 2025-03-21.
